item.description:
Explains what summaries need, and how to point at it

  • A setup card in the menu explains when the Claude Code CLI is missing, instead of quietly hiding the summarize button
  • The Claude desktop app is not the CLI — if only the app is installed, the card says so by name
  • Locate… lets you pick the binary yourself; it is verified with --version before being accepted, and remembered

Finds the Claude CLI, and says when it has updated

  • The summarize button was missing for anyone whose PATH lives in ~/.zshrc — the lookup used a non-interactive shell, which never reads that file
  • Installing an update used to be completely silent: the menu bar icon now carries a checkmark and the menu shows what version you are on
  • Settings explains when the Claude CLI is missing, with a button to look again after installing it

Fixes transcription hanging on long meetings

  • Important: a transcription of roughly an hour or more could hang indefinitely. The recording was never at risk — press retry and it transcribes normally.
  • Progress is now shown as a percentage in the menu and a progress bar in the transcript window, instead of an endless spinner
  • A running transcription can be stopped or restarted; previously a wedged one had no escape hatch
  • A run that produces no output for fifteen minutes is cancelled rather than spinning forever

Microsoft Teams, and a permission screen that explains itself

  • Teams joins Slack, Meet and full screen as a capture source — the native client or a browser tab, whichever is on screen
  • Screen and microphone access are now requested from a panel in the menu, with a button each, instead of silently failing on the first recording
  • Granting screen access to a running app does nothing until relaunch, so the panel detects that and offers a Restart button

Notarized by Apple, and four more languages

  • Signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized — the app now opens with a normal double-click, no security warning
  • Ukrainian, Spanish and German added alongside English and Russian; speaker labels and summaries follow the language of the call
  • Copy notes turns a summary into a message ready to paste into Slack or email
  • Fixed: the recordings list never appeared in the menu bar popover
  • Fixed: summary headings showed as literal "## Topics"

No setup commands

  • whisper.cpp is now compiled into the app — Homebrew is no longer required
  • The speech model is downloaded from the menu with a progress bar instead of curl

First public release

  • Records Slack, Google Meet, or the full screen via ScreenCaptureKit
  • On-device transcription with whisper.cpp, speaker labels without diarization
  • Optional call summaries through the Claude CLI
  • Global ⌘⇧R hotkey and searchable history
